preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices N in each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.
The total number of vertices across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(C) == N and all(c in 'RGB' for c in C)
preconditions.description: The string C must have a length equal to N and consist only of characters 'R', 'G', and 'B'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case must be either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: any(c == 'B' for c in C) and all(any(c == 'R' for c in path) and any(c == 'G' for c in path) for u, v in blue_pairs)
postconditions.description: For each pair of Blue vertices, there must be at least one Red and one Green vertex on the path between them.
